About

More than a YouTube channel.

MANII VLOGX is built around authentic student experiences and conversations from the education ecosystem.

What is MANII VLOGX?

MANII VLOGX is a student and youth-focused education media platform covering JEE, NEET, competitive exams, educators, coaching institutes, student experiences and education events.

Through interviews, campus coverage, podcasts, reviews and digital content, the platform connects students with real voices and useful perspectives.
